# Match

## Summary
The club's fixture — a Match IS an Event. The subclass adds who we play
(`opponent`), where the tie stands (`homeAway`, `competition`) and the
box office's running sales tally (`ticketsSold`); kickoff, venue, capacity
and status are consumed unchanged from the Event block.

## API
- `opponent` — StringField; drives the computed duel title (`v X` / `at X`)
- `homeAway` — Home | Away (colors the calendar and the chips)
- `competition` — League | Cup | Friendly
- `ticketsSold` — the box office's own total (includes season tickets and
  sales outside this system), a stored baseline ops maintains — deliberately
  NOT a count of Booking cards

## Formats
All four are Match's own: the isolated is a match-day page (duel header,
box-office panel with sold bar and SOLD OUT state, venue, about); fitted
carries a date anchor with a badge-degradation rung.

The linked example is the sold-tracked league fixture the app's bookings
point at.
